title: finding: showcase `RecalcSelectionAction` TSDoc still narrates the pre-objectui#3142 "missing/empty locations → every location" rule
body:
Observation-class finding, tripped over while executing #7323 (inverting the same stale claim in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`). Filed unassigned, no `pm:queue` — for triage to grade. Nothing a product user hits; it is stale explanatory prose in an example app.

## What

`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts`, the TSDoc above `RecalcSelectionAction` (around L138-149 on `origin/main` `1788e19`), states the pre-objectui#3142 placement rule as current fact:

> `locations` still has to be declared, even though the selection bar entry comes from the view. Omitting it does NOT mean "nowhere": the action:bar renderer treats a missing/empty `locations` as "every location" (objectui `action-bar.tsx`), so a locations-less action also lands on the LIST TOOLBAR — where there is no selection, so the dispatch posts no `_selectedIds` and the endpoint rejects it. Declaring `record_more` keeps the single-record entry somewhere it works (the endpoint's per-record branch, via `recordIdParam`) and off the toolbar. See objectui#3142.

Omitting `locations` **does** now mean "nowhere". objectui#3142 collapsed four disagreeing renderers onto a single membership predicate, `actionRendersAt` (`objectui packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`), so an undeclared or empty `locations` matches no location at all.

## Evidence, in this repo

`packages/lint/src/validate-action-locations.ts` is built on the opposite rule, and its docblock states it explicitly:

> The renderer half is now unambiguous: objectui#3142 collapsed four disagreeing renderers onto one predicate — an action renders at a location only if it DECLARES that location. Before that, `action:bar` and the record header showed an undeclared action *everywhere*, which is what made this shape look alive; it is measurably inert as of objectui 17.1.

The whole `action-no-placement` rule exists **because** a locations-less action renders nowhere. So the lint package and this fixture comment currently say opposite things about the same behavior.

## Why it is worth a card

The comment is not decorative — it is cited as a `source` by the QA checklist item `records-forms.action-location-matrix`, and it is very plausibly where that item's now-corrected "empty-locations means EVERY location" probe came from in the first place. A runner or author who follows the `source` link lands back on the stale rule after #7323 fixed the downstream copy.

**The declaration the comment explains is correct either way**: `locations: ['record_more']` is right, and `RecalcSelectionAction` needs no change. Only the *reason given* has inverted — `record_more` is an explicit single-record placement (which incidentally keeps it off the toolbar), not an opt-out of an everywhere-default.

Worth checking in the same pass: the file's header TSDoc and `NewTaskAction`'s comment both discuss `locations: []` as "a declaration in its own right, not an omission", which reads correctly post-#3142 — the defect looks localized to the `RecalcSelectionAction` block, but the sweep should confirm rather than assume.

## Deliberately not fixed in PR for #7323

#7323's dispatch pinned the file surface to `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` with a stop-on-breach clause, and Prime Directive #10 keeps unrelated fixes out of that PR. That PR instead annotates the `source` entry so the stale prose is flagged in place until this card is worked.

## Scope

Comment-only edit to `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` (plus the sweep above). No behavior change, no spec change.
